key_insight: KANs can predict airfoil pressure distributions well and interpolate across flight conditions, but in this study they do not clearly outperform a well-tuned MLP and are surpassed by a GNN.
engineering_relevance: For aerodynamic surrogate modeling, KANs offer a potentially lower-complexity, faster-training alternative, but model choice still depends on accuracy targets and optimization effort.
method: Train KAN, MLP, and GNN surrogates for surface pressure prediction on subsonic and transonic airfoils.
Evaluate interpolation across Mach number and angle of attack.
Compare predictive accuracy, model complexity, and training cost.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports that KAN performance is comparable to, but slightly below, a suitably trained MLP, while the GNN achieves the best accuracy at the cost of longer training.
watch_item: KANs showed training instabilities and strong sensitivity to hyperparameter tuning, which may limit reliable deployment.
paper_title: Kolmogorov Arnold networks (KAN) for aerodynamic prediction: a comparison with MLPs and GNNs
